# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **HarfBuzz upgrade and script coverage**

## Highlights

The upcoming release pairs HarfBuzz 15.0.0 with expanded named script coverage in HarfBuzzSharp. Thirty additional Script fields include Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing script values, parsing and numeric conversions remain unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **HarfBuzz 15.0.0** — Updates the bundled native library and moves HarfBuzzSharp and its NativeAssets packages to version 15.0.0. The HarfBuzzSharp assembly version remains 1.0.0.0. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## API Surface

- **Named constants for every bundled script** — Adds 30 static readonly Script fields, bringing named coverage to 179 native script tags. The existing struct-based API, all 149 prior fields and their values, parsing, conversions and horizontal-direction lookup are preserved. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))
